2027 Investment Services Internship

New York, New York, United States, Stamford, Connecticut, United States

About the Investment Services internship

Interns in Investment Services spend ten weeks in one of the teams that keep the firm running, such as compliance, finance, legal, operations or technology strategy. You will own a real project, present your results at the end of the summer and learn how a global hedge fund is organised.

Alongside your team work, the programme includes:

  • Mentoring from experienced colleagues
  • Sessions with senior leaders about their careers
  • Intern events, volunteering and social activities

What’s required

  • Currently studying for a bachelor’s degree
  • Interest in the asset management industry
  • Strong attention to detail and good analytical and writing skills
  • Able to manage several tasks and deadlines at once

The base salary for interns is set out in the posting; final pay depends on location and experience.
